*[[Destruction of the Cauldron Nebula|Destruction]] of the [[Cauldron Nebula/Legends|Cauldron Nebula]] and the [[Carida system/Legends|Carida system]]<ref name="cotf">''[[Champions of the Force]]''</ref>}}
The following events took place in '''11 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]]'''.

==Events==
{{Quote|From this moment on, General, you have but one mission&mdash;find Kir Kanos!|Carnor Jax to Redd Wessel|audio=Carnor-FindKirKanos.flac|<ref name="C1">[[Crimson Empire 1|''Crimson Empire'' 1]]</ref>}}
*[[Krinemonen]] and [[Hirsi]] were destroyed by the [[Galaxy Gun]].<ref name="ea">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
*[[Byss/Legends|Byss]] was [[Destruction of Byss|destroyed]] by the last projectile of the Galaxy Gun, in which the Galaxy Gun was hoped to destroy the ''[[Eclipse II]]'', only for the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] to collide with the Galaxy Gun, destroying it, as well as the ''Eclipse II''.<ref name="EE" />
*[[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], in his last [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] body, attempted to [[Essence transfer|transfer]] his spirit into the infant [[Anakin Solo]], but was shot by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], and his spirit was trapped forever in the [[Netherworld of the Force/Legends|Netherworld of the Force]], thanks to [[Empatojayos Brand]].<ref name="EE" />
*The [[Order of the Sith Lords]] is unable to return and perishes
*The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] reoccupies [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], thus reclaiming authority of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], after relocating their temporary capital from [[Dac/Legends|Dac]].
*[[Operation Shadow Hand]] was halted with the final [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Palpatine and the destruction of Byss.<ref name="nec">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>
*[[Blitzer Harrsk]], [[Treuten Teradoc]], and [[Sander Delvardus]] re-established their former [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] dominions in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]].<ref name="ea" />
*The [[Dark Empire]] is reorganised into the [[Crimson Empire]].
*[[New Alderaan/Legends|New Alderaan]] was liberated from the Dark Empire by the New Republic for a second time.
*The [[New Republic Provisional Council]] was replaced by the [[New Republic Ruling Council]].<ref name="nec" />
*[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] established a [[Jedi Praxeum]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] and declared himself a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]].<ref name="da" />
*The [[New Jedi Order]] was created with Yavin 4 as the center.
*[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] accidentally crashed his personal [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing starfighter]] into the [[Cathedral of Winds/Legends|Cathedral of Winds]] on [[Vortex/Legends|Vortex]], [[Destruction of the Cathedral of Winds|destroying]] the building and killing hundreds of [[Vor]]s.<ref name="da" />
*[[Destruction of the Cauldron Nebula|Destruction]] of the [[Cauldron Nebula/Legends|Cauldron Nebula]]<ref name="da" /> and the [[Carida system/Legends|Carida system]]<ref name="cotf" /> by [[Kyp Durron]] via the [[Sun Crusher]].
*[[New Republic Presidential election, 11 ABY|New Republic Presidential election]]; [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] replaced [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] as [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]].
*The [[Death Star prototype]] was damaged by Kyp Durron then lured to a nearby [[Black hole/Legends|black hole]] and sucked there together with the Sun Crusher.<ref name="cotf" />
*[[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] attended Luke Skywalker's [[Jedi academy]] to learn the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] in order to save his kidnapped wife, [[Mirax Terrik Horn|Mirax Terrik]].<ref name="I, Jedi">''[[I, Jedi]]''</ref>
*[[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun's]] spirit destroyed the [[Tedryn Holocron]] in the Jedi Praxeum.<ref name="da" />
*Exar Kun's spirit was defeated.<ref name="cotf" />
